Assessment/Plan:
• Chronic hepatitis B - The patient has been under our care since 2017 when she was diagnosed with chronic hepatitis B. Her condition is currently well-controlled with antiviral therapy. The patient is taking entecavir 0.5 mg daily. Her liver function tests and viral load are within acceptable ranges. We continue to monitor her closely to ensure the hepatitis B virus remains suppressed.
• Upper Respiratory Infection (URI) - On July 22, 2024, the patient presented with symptoms of an upper respiratory infection, including nasal congestion, sore throat, and mild cough. She was treated symptomatically with over-the-counter medications and advised to maintain adequate hydration and rest. She recovered uneventfully within a week.
• Tobacco use - The patient is a former smoker, having smoked half a pack per day until she quit on June 21, 2024. She has been honest about her tobacco use and has no current use.
• Alcohol consumption - The patient reports consuming approximately six alcoholic drinks per week. We have discussed the potential risks of alcohol consumption in the context of her chronic hepatitis B, emphasizing the importance of moderation.

Vitals:
During her most recent visit on September 6, 2025, her blood pressure was recorded at 125/73 mmHg, and her weight was 113 pounds. Her vital signs have remained stable throughout her care.

Social History:
The patient has a family history of hypertension, as her mother was diagnosed at age 66, although the mother's current status is unknown. The patient has been compliant with her medication regimen and regular follow-ups. She has no other significant social history or other relevant past medical conditions.

Medications:
The patient is currently on entecavir 0.5 mg daily for the management of her chronic hepatitis B.

Summary:
Mary Gonzales has been under consistent care for her chronic hepatitis B, which is currently controlled with entecavir. She had a self-limited episode of an upper respiratory infection in July 2024, which resolved without complications.

Her social history includes a history of tobacco use that she quit in June 2024, and she consumes alcohol at a level. Her overall health status is stable, with regular monitoring and management of her chronic condition.
